catalog.title: TEMPLATE SEARCHER
catalog.desc: Find any word or phrase across every template in bd_templates. Decompresses on the fly, highlights matches, groups by template. Admin-only.
catalog.action: if (window.eli && window.eli.dispatch) window.eli.dispatch('tile', 'app_template_searcher'); else if (typeof showTemplateSearcher === 'function') showTemplateSearcher(); else if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Template Searcher not loaded.', 'error');
